settingsApplyNotice: Model and permission changes apply to new sessions.
modelsUnavailable: The model list could not be loaded from the Copilot CLI (is it installed and signed in?). Enter a model id, or leave empty for the CLI default.
rulesDescription: Configure custom instructions for Copilot CLI. copilot-instructions.md is read at the start of every session, so project conventions, commands, and preferences written here shape how Copilot works.
mcpDescription: Add MCP servers to Copilot CLI. User servers are stored in ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json and project servers in .github/mcp.json. Disabled servers are listed in ~/.copilot/settings.json.
skillsDescription: Skills give Copilot CLI reusable instructions it loads on demand. Each skill is a SKILL.md file under ~/.copilot/skills or the project's .github/skills. Disabled skills are listed in ~/.copilot/settings.json.
skillNamePatternError: Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens only (e.g. my-skill)
